purpose: Offline tick/decision step and named breakpoint stop at safe reproducible boundaries; live history/bookmark never pauses/mutates multiplayer

acceptance.requiredOutcome: Offline tick/decision step and named breakpoint stop at safe reproducible boundaries; live history/bookmark never pauses/mutates multiplayer
setup: An isolated captured match and a separate real live multiplayer session are both active
Named safe breakpoints use validated bounded predicates rather than arbitrary code
actions: Step isolated replay by one tick and one completed decision, then stop at a named application/progress breakpoint
In live session change history view and add a bookmark
measurements: Safe boundary tick, pending async work, command sequence and continuation equality
Live peer tick/hash advancement during read-only debug actions
required: Offline stepping stops only after the requested safe completed boundary and resumes equivalently
Live history/bookmark never pauses or mutates gameplay
forbidden: Global multiplayer pause from a debug bookmark

capabilityLimits: Actual isolated SP replay steps one native tick, one completed decision and the original paid queue item progress under finite validated predicates, then must match full uninterrupted physical continuation.

A separate real two-client live match exercises actual Shift-wheel history and Ctrl-click bookmark/Alt-click return handlers. Native full projection and pause reasons must remain unchanged synchronously, and both clients must exchange later matching hashes.
Physical stepping rejects attached multiplayer before advancing anything. This registration does not add multiplayer pause/save/load or arbitrary predicate evaluation.
